title: Manual Wastewater Concentration and Extraction V1.0
author: Allison Steedman
materials: Ceres Nanotrap Microbiome A Particle beads

steps.title: Concentrate Wastewater with Nanotrap Beads
steps.instruction: Concentrate the wastewater sample using Ceres Nanotrap Microbiome A Particle beads.

substeps.instruction: Aliquot 10mL of wastewater into a 15mL conical tube.
Add 150ul Ceres Nanotrap Microbiome A Particle beads into the 10mL of wastewater and invert to mix.
Incubate at room temperature for 15 minutes on a slow shaker (or invert every 5 minutes).
Place the 15mL conical tube on a magnetic stand for 5 minutes or until beads are fully separated.
Pipette off the supernatant into a new 1.5mL tube and discard the bead pellet.

steps.title: Lysis and Bead Capture
steps.instruction: Capture the concentrated sample on beads and perform lysis.

substeps.instruction: Place the 1.5mL tube containing the supernatant on a magnetic stand for 2 minutes or until beads are fully separated.
Incubate at room temperature for 10 minutes on a slow shaker.
Remove from the magnet and add 500ul MagMax Lysis Buffer.
Resuspend the pellet and transfer to a 1.5mL tube.

steps.title: Prepare Binding Mixture
steps.instruction: Combine the lysate with binding reagents in a 1.5mL conical tube.

substeps.instruction: Add 500ul Binding Solution, 20ul Beads, 10ul Proteinase K, and 400ul Sample/Lysate (using reagents from MagMAX Viral/Pathogen Kit A42352).
Vortex to mix.

steps.title: Wash the Bead Pellet
steps.instruction: Perform sequential washes to purify the captured material.

substeps.instruction: Take the tube off the magnetic rack, add 1000ul MagMax Wash Buffer, and resuspend the bead pellet.
Place the 1.5mL conical tube on the magnetic rack for 2 minutes or until beads are fully separated.
Incubate for 10 minutes.
While the tube is still on the magnet, add 1000μl of 80% EtOH, incubate for 30 seconds, and remove the EtOH wash.
Place the 1.5mL conical tube on the magnetic rack for 2 minutes or until beads are fully separated.
Repeat the 80% EtOH wash step (add 1000μl 80% EtOH, incubate 30 seconds, and remove).

steps.title: Elute and Recover Sample
steps.instruction: Elute the final sample and prepare for storage.

substeps.instruction: Remove the tube from the magnet.
Add 50ul of MagMax Elution solution, then pipette and vortex to resuspend.
Incubate at room temperature for 10 minutes.
Place the tube/plate on the magnet to air dry for 3 minutes.
Place the tube onto the magnet and transfer the supernatant to the final tube.
Store the sample at -80°C or proceed to downstream analysis.
